kind: operational only: no design, prediction or scorer change
state_when_written: Tier A resumed 14 Oct: 19 of 80 runs ok; 61 ended 'failed' because the OpenAI account had no credits left (HTTP 429 insufficient_quota) in every one of them: 25 MATMCD, 24 causaliq, 7 Vashishtha, 5 PyWhy-LLM. Tier A spend $12.21.

changes.what: a provider refusal for billing (HTTP 429 insufficient_quota / 'no credits remaining') is an infrastructure stop, recorded as 'aborted_quota' (exit 5), resumable like a cap hit; runs recorded as 'failed' with that message before this change are recognised by their message and resume too
changes.why: the prereg's failure rule already allows retrying infrastructure failures; the harness could not tell a quota refusal from an agent failure, so 61 runs were recorded as agent failures

changes.what: the first quota stop ends the launching of new runs (batch exit 5)
changes.why: after the credits ran out the batch kept starting runs that failed within seconds (59 runs at $0.00)
